deepseek/deepseek-v3.notes: 671B main-model parameters; checkpoint files additionally include a 14B multi-token-prediction module.

deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash.notes: 552B is the nominal backbone count; an additional 196B Engram memory is separately reported. A complete checkpoint total is not established here. Active parameters are 8B for prefill and 16B for decode; the scalar records decode. Original September 10 checkpoint; the live deepseek-flash API was upgraded to V4.1-Flash-1017 on October 17.

deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017.notes: 552B is the nominal backbone count; the technical report separately lists 196B Engram parameters (748B nominal combined), while Hugging Face tensor metadata displays 763B for the checkpoint. Active parameters are phase-dependent: 8B per input token during prefill and 16B per output token during decode. The 1017 card links the launch report; its config is byte-identical to the launch config. Context is advertised as 1M; the weights configure 1,048,576 positions.

abacusai/dracarys-llama-3.1-70b-instruct.notes: 70B is nominal; the published BF16 checkpoint contains 70,553,706,496 parameters. Dense model; active parameters are not separately reported. August 14, 2024 is the first checkpoint-upload date, not a verified public-launch date. License conflict: Abacus card declares Llama 3, while its named Llama 3.1 base declares Llama 3.1. Model config allows 131072 positions, but tokenizer model_max_length is 2048. Fine-tune-specific reasoning-mode and tool-call support remain unverified.

ai21/jamba-large.description: AI21's Jamba Large 1.7, a text-only hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts model for long-context instruction following and grounded generation
ai21/jamba-large.notes: Reviewed alias target: jamba-large-1.7-2025-07. Counts are AI21's nominal 398B total / 94B active; public tensor metadata counts 398,555,145,696 parameters. Context 256000 normalizes the advertised 256K, not an independently verified exact implementation limit. Weights require acceptance of custom license conditions. Dedicated reasoning-mode status remains unverified.

ai21/jamba-mini.description: AI21 Jamba2 Mini, a text-generation model with hybrid Mamba-Transformer layers and mixture-of-experts routing, released for enterprise question answering and instruction following.
ai21/jamba-mini.notes: Current documented jamba-mini alias maps to jamba-mini-2-2026-01 (Jamba2 Mini). Parameter counts are nominal developer figures: 52B total, 12B active. The MoE routing sits within a hybrid Mamba-Transformer backbone. API context is published as 256K; the downloadable checkpoint config specifies 262144, while 256000 is only the catalog decimal normalization. API callability was not tested.

aion-labs/aion-3.0.notes: Developer describes a GLM-family collaborative multi-model system, without identifying component versions, total/active parameter counts, or dense/MoE composition. No Aion 3.0 weight release or weight license was verified. Developer release date is 2026-05-05; OpenRouter instead labels 2026-07-07 as release.

aion-labs/aion-3.0-mini.description: DeepSeek-based collaborative multi-model system for narrative generation and storytelling
aion-labs/aion-3.0-mini.notes: Aion Labs describes a collaborative system using multiple DeepSeek-family models, without identifying component checkpoints or disclosing total/active parameter counts or neural architecture. Its official release date is 2026-05-14; OpenRouter lists 2026-07-07.

aion-labs/aion-rp-llama-3.1-8b.description: Llama 3.1 8B fine-tune for roleplaying and creative writing.
aion-labs/aion-rp-llama-3.1-8b.notes: 8B is nominal; published weights contain 8,030,261,248 parameters. Active parameters are not separately reported. API context is 32,768 tokens; the downloadable fine-tune config supports 131,072 positions. Developer reports release on 2024-11-30, while the repository was created on 2024-11-09. Fine-tune metadata declares Apache-2.0, but its Llama 3.1 base has a separate community license; the complete licensing position is unresolved.

aisingapore/gemma-sea-lion-v4-27b-it.notes: 27B is the developer's nominal size; published BF16 tensor metadata totals 27.43240664B including vision. Dense architecture has no separately reported active-per-token count. 128K resolves to 131072 positions in the Gemma 3 configuration. Dedicated reasoning-mode support is unverified; ordinary reasoning tasks do not establish a thinking-model flag.

alibaba/qwen2.5-7b-instruct.description: Open-weight 7.61B-parameter dense Qwen2.5 instruction model for text chat, structured output, and tool use
alibaba/qwen2.5-7b-instruct.notes: 7.61B is the developer-reported rounded total; 6.53B is non-embedding, not active parameters. Active count is not separately defined for this dense model. Maximum context is 131,072 with YaRN; the shipped configuration defaults to 32,768. Reasoning=false refers to absence of a dedicated thinking mode, not absence of general reasoning ability.

alibaba/qwen2.5-coder-0.5b.description: Qwen2.5-Coder base language model for code generation and fill-in-the-middle completion, released with open weights under Apache 2.0.
alibaba/qwen2.5-coder-0.5b.notes: This is the pretrained base checkpoint, not the Instruct variant. Developer-rounded total is 0.49B; current Safetensors metadata counts 494,032,768 parameters. The 0.36B non-embedding figure is not an active-parameter count. Dense active parameters are not separately defined. Tool-formatting support in the tokenizer does not establish tool-calling competence of the base weights; dedicated reasoning-mode support also remains unverified.

alibaba/qwen2.5-coder-32b-instruct.description: Open-weight instruction-tuned Qwen coding model for code generation, repair, and code reasoning.
alibaba/qwen2.5-coder-32b-instruct.notes: 32B is nominal branding. The official card declares 32.5B; official checkpoint metadata reports 32,763,876,352 parameters. Active parameters are not separately reported. Context is 32,768 tokens by default, extended to 131,072 with the documented YaRN factor-4 configuration. Dedicated reasoning-mode status remains unverified.

alibaba/qwen3-235b-a22b.notes: Original April 2025 hybrid thinking/non-thinking checkpoint, distinct from Instruct-2507 and Thinking-2507. 235B total and 22B active are nominal developer-reported counts. Context is 32,768 tokens natively and validated to 131,072 with YaRN factor 4; default config has max_position_embeddings=40,960 and rope_scaling=null. Alibaba Model Studio enables dynamic YaRN by default. Release date uses the explicit April 29 developer announcement; repository uploads on April 28 do not establish public availability.

alibaba/qwen2-5-vl-72b-instruct.notes: 72B is the nominal label; the complete BF16 checkpoint has 73.410777344B parameters, including 0.704573696B in the visual encoder and merger. Active parameters are not separately defined. Context 128000 follows the shipped model positional configuration; tokenizer length 131072 is a preprocessing setting. The card describes 32768 and optional YaRN, and the report documents 32768 training sequences, so configured context does not establish long-text quality. A dedicated reasoning-mode boolean remains unverified.

alibaba/qwen-flash.description: Hosted Qwen3 text model with optional thinking and a one-million-token context window.

Official availability: August 1, 2025 (International/Global), August 5 (Beijing). Parameters and architecture remain undisclosed. Do not transfer specifications from open Qwen3 checkpoints or later numbered Flash models. Function calling is documented generally and for Beijing, but the exact-model regional tables mark other regions unsupported.

alibaba/qwen-max.description: Hosted Qwen text model for multilingual chat and coding, currently mapped to the Qwen2.5-Max snapshot.
alibaba/qwen-max.notes: Rolling hosted alias: MoE architecture refers to the documented qwen-max-2025-01-25 (Qwen2.5-Max) mapping. Exact total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed. Current context is unresolved: exact model cards state 32768, including the October 11, 2026 international card; the October 15 overview says 128k. No region-specific context difference or upgrade announcement was verified. Function calling is supported in Beijing but marked unsupported in Singapore. Initial alias release date is unverified; the alias was listed by September 19, 2024, separately from the 0403 snapshot. January 28, 2025 announces the later Qwen2.5-Max snapshot.

alibaba/qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct.description: Qwen3 MoE coding model with 30.5B total and 3.3B active parameters, native 256K context, non-thinking mode and tool calling.

alibaba/qwen3-coder-480b-a35b-instruct.notes: 480B total and 35B activated per token are developer-reported nominal counts. Native context is 262,144 tokens; 1M requires extrapolation. Non-thinking output mode.

alibaba/qwen3-coder-flash.description: Qwen3-based code generation model for repository understanding and multi-turn tool interaction.
alibaba/qwen3-coder-flash.notes: July 28, 2025 is the snapshot date; Alibaba lists the Global/International service release on July 29. Exact hosted-alias parameter counts, architecture and open-checkpoint equivalence are not established. Current official overview says thinking mode is supported, conflicting with catalog reasoning=false; detailed regional function-calling tables also differ.

alibaba/qwen3-coder-next.notes: Counts are nominal publisher figures for the exact Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next instruct checkpoint. Architecture combines Gated DeltaNet and gated attention with MoE. Announcement indexing says February 2, while model-card release material is dated February 3; only month precision is asserted.
